ideal: A short alert: Tesla filed an 8-K (current-events report) saying it entered a material agreement, ended another one, and took on a new direct financial obligation, with the link. It should add no unsupported details.

verdicts.note: It covers all items accurately with the link, though calling 9.01 'material' and the 'no price move data' line add a little clutter.
verdicts.answer: Tesla filed an 8-K (current-events report) covering four material items: entering a material definitive agreement (1.01), terminating a material definitive agreement (1.02), creating a direct financial obligation (2.03), and filing financial statements (9.01). No price move data in the report.
